utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hi Ira — are we still on for the repair drive this Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yep, I’m still in for Saturday. I’ll swing by after my errands and bring what I can.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great—what time should I expect you?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Noah—I've got a few tools I can lend for the repair drive. Just let me know what you need.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, thanks Gus — I might need a wrench and maybe that drill if you’ve got it.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Absolutely — I can bring a wrench and the drill by later today. Just tell me when and where to drop them off.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive? I heard it’s coming together nicely—lots of folks are pitching in. If you want, I can tell you what I’ve heard so far.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Tess—I'd like to hear, especially when and where folks are dropping things off.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sure thing—last I heard, folks can drop things off Saturday morning at the community center parking lot. I’ll let you know if I hear any last-minute changes.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need me to bring or do?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Could you bring the box of tools to the community center on Maple Street, and then help sort donations by room?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll bring the box of tools to the community center on Maple Street and help sort the donations by room.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Uli, I’m spreading the word about the repair drive now—if you want, I can add your name to the invite list too.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Quinn. You can add me to the list.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—happy to add you. I’ll pass along the repair drive invite right away.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, Leo — I’m putting the repair drive details together now, and I’ll keep everything organized so it’s easy for everyone to join in.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Rosa — send me the details when they’re ready, and I’ll help spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, Leo — I’ll send you a neat summary with the date, time, and what we’re collecting once it’s finalized.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you tell me the exact time and what supplies we’re still missing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m not sure on the exact time yet, but I can check and get back to you. As for supplies, I’ll see what’s still missing and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Dane — please do check the time and missing supplies, and let me know as soon as you have them.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate that around the school schedule—just let me know what time the repair drive needs us.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Faye — that would help a lot. I’ll confirm the repair drive time and get back to you so we can fit it around the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sounds good — once you have the time, send it over and I’ll work it into the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I’ve only heard bits and pieces about the repair drive—what’s the latest on it?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: It’s coming together nicely — folks are signing up, and we’re trying to get a better sense of which repairs are most urgent first.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’s great to hear — I’ve only caught a few updates, but I can help spread the word if there’s a list of the biggest needs.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, I can help—what needs fixing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So you’re definitely helping with the repair drive, right?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I’m in—just tell me what you need me to do.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help where I can—what still needs doing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, thanks, Rey — I’m a bit scattered, but I think we still need a few hands for the heavy lifting and maybe someone to sort the tools.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can sort the tools and help with the heavy lifting if you need me.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’ll keep repeating the repair drive plans so everyone stays in the loop.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Vik — I’ll keep an eye on our supply list and pass along anything we still need.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good, Cleo — I’ll keep echoing the repair drive plans to everyone so nothing gets missed.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, I heard the repair drive is coming along nicely. I can swing by after my errands if you need anything dropped off.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That’d be really kind, thanks. If you come by, I could use a hand with a few boxes.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure thing — I’ll stop by after I finish my errands and help with the boxes.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — the repair drive. I’m still a bit mixed up, but I’m happy to help however I can.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, thanks, Oren — I’ll keep you posted on the repair drive plans and let you know where you can jump in.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Vik — that’d be great. Just remind me when and where, and I’ll do my best to show up.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, the repair drive? I’m a little out of the loop—what’s changed so far?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Mostly just the basics so far—folks are still gathering tools and making a list of what needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it—thanks. I’ll swing by and see if I can help with the list or tools.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Eli — I can lend a hand and bring over any tools you need for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Gus. Let’s keep it simple: I’ll make a list, and you can bring the tools over in the morning.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Eli — I’ll check your list in the morning and bring over the tools you need.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Quinn—I'm ready to help with the repair drive. What do you need from me first?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great—can you help me spread the word and make a quick list of what folks can bring? I’ll handle the invites and keep everyone posted.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word and put together a quick bring-list for folks. Send me any details you want included, and I’ll get on it.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’m happy to help connect people for the repair drive. What do you need me to coordinate?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Jules — I need you to help pin down who’s bringing which tools and where everyone should meet for pickup.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Got it — I’ll sort out the tools and set a clear pickup spot. I’ll check in with everyone and get back to you soon.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, Cleo — I’m putting the repair drive pieces in order now, and I’ll keep you posted on what’s needed next.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, Rosa — I’ll keep an eye on our supplies and let you know if anything’s running low.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, Cleo — that’ll help a lot. I’ll sort the next steps and circle back once I’ve got the list together.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard the repair drive is still on, but I only got the update second-hand. Do you know what they still need?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I’m not sure yet — have they said whether they still need tools, volunteers, or parts?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I haven’t heard the details yet, just that it’s still going. If I learn more, I’ll let you know.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good—what do you need me to bring or fix?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Could you bring the drill and the spare screws? If you can help check the loose hinge on the side gate, that’d be great.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, I can bring the drill and spare screws, and I’ll take a look at the side gate hinge too.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing, Kira — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, you’re saying you’ll help with the repair drive, right?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes, that’s right — I’ll help with the repair drive.
